text:
Maya Patel: paging in — we just saw a p99 spike on /v1/chat/completions for model=mistral-7b around 12:03 UTC. Pager fired, customers reported 502s for streaming sessions.
Dan Liu: on it. looks like a surge from a single customer workspace, ramped from 20rps -> 400rps in ~30s.
Priya Rao: confirmed impact: error-rate 4.2% for the route during the window, latency p95 up to 1.2s, p99 to 3.8s. customers affected: 2 paying accounts, a few trials.
Maya Patel: severity: P2 by customer impact, but noisy alerts. we should do mitigation then post-incident tuning.
Dan Liu: mitigation applied: added temp rate-limit for that workspace (50rps) and nudged routing to fallback pool. dropped error-rate to 0.1% in ~90s.
Priya Rao: good. can we adjust alerts so we don't page on short-lived customer floods? current rule: route_p99_latency > 2000ms for 5m -> page.
Maya Patel: that fires a lot during bursts. propose: change to p99 > 2500ms sustained for 10m OR p95 > 1500ms for 5m as secondary. also split by model and route.
Dan Liu: +1 split by model. Mistral-7b patterns differ from mix-architecture routes. Also add suppressions for known maintenance windows.
Priya Rao: drafting recommended alert update:
```yaml
- alert: ChatRouteLatencyHigh
  expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, latency_ms{route=~"/v1/chat.*"}[10m]) > 2500
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
- alert: ChatRouteLatencyHigh-Transient
  expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, latency_ms{route=~"/v1/chat.*"}[5m]) > 1500
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: ticket
```
Maya Patel: looks reasonable. add per-model override to lower sensitivity for bursty models:
```yaml
- alert: ChatRouteLatencyHigh-Mistral7b
  expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, latency_ms{model="mistral-7b",route=~"/v1/chat.*"}[15m]) > 3000
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
Dan Liu: also add a rate-of-change check so a tiny sustained p99 doesn't page if throughput is near zero: e.g., require request_rate > 1rps.
Priya Rao: agree. adding `AND request_rate{route=...,model=...} > 1` to expressions.
Maya Patel: for the oncall playbook, add a quick checklist:
- confirm customer scope (account id)
- apply temporary rate-limit or workspace QoS
- route to fallback pool if capacity saturated
- monitor for 10m after mitigation before closing
Dan Liu: copying playbook snippet into the runbook now. also creating a dashboard panel per-route p95/p99 + request_rate for quicker triage.
Priya Rao: dashboard idea: heatmap rows=route, cols=model, cells show p99 latency and request_rate. color thresholds at 1500/2500/4000ms.
Maya Patel: can we add an alert-squelch automation: if `mitigation_annotation=rate_limited` present, suppress pages for 30m?
Dan Liu: yep, we can tag incidents when we apply mitigation and have the alertmanager silence rule use that label.
Alex (ops-bot): automated note: created silence ID=slc-20260315-001 for 30m by Dan Liu (rate_limited).
Priya Rao: post-incident actions: update alert definitions, add per-model sensitivity, create the heatmap dashboard, and schedule a 1h retro with SRE + Platform in 24h.
Maya Patel: assigning owners: Dan -> alert changes + silence automation, Priya -> dashboard + playbook update, Maya -> customer communication + retro.
Dan Liu: will push a PR to alerting repo with the YAML changes and include unit tests for query semantics.
Priya Rao: quick note on thresholds: we should validate changes against last 90 days of telemetry to avoid regressions. I'll run the historical query and post results here.
Maya Patel: thanks. tagging @pagerduty-bot to close the page once owners confirm mitigation success.
pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved: PD-78912: Pager acknowledged and mitigated (link: https://pd.example/PD-78912).
Maya Patel: closing thread—will follow up in retro and include sample queries and the historical validation results. :white_check_mark:
